interpretation: descriptive support coverage, not a probability of deployment validity and not a row-exclusion rule
knn: Euclidean distance in robust-scaled seven-feature space; external fifth-nearest distance compared with the empirical 95th percentile of NWC leave-self-out fifth-nearest distances
pca: whitened PCA fitted on robust-scaled NWC, retaining at least 95% variance; joint score-radius and reconstruction-error envelope
robust_mahalanobis: Minimum Covariance Determinant fitted on robust-scaled NWC; empirical NWC 95th-percentile envelope
scaler: RobustScaler fitted on NWC median/IQR only
